__baseline_prompt__.text: A surreal photographic scene led by an impossible support relationship. A woman resembling the supplied portrait stands upside down on the curved underside of a brick arcade: both shoe soles rest flush against the overhead masonry, her straight legs descend from those contacts toward her inverted torso, and her head hangs below her shoulders toward the ordinary street. This departure from ordinary gravity dominates the entire photograph. Frame her near the mouth of the arcade, large enough to recognize her face, with the arch sweeping across the top and a strip of upright street below. The lower street contains a vertical black lamppost, a pavement curb and the base of the opposite building, clearly establishing the ordinary world's upright direction. Her two feet occupy neighboring bricks on one shallow section of the arch, separated by a natural hip-width stance; the contact edges and both shoes remain visible against the pale mortar. Her body continues in one unbroken anatomical chain below them, arms relaxed beside her torso and hands open. Her dark bob falls gently toward the street, individual short strands and wispy fringe outlining her inverted face. Preserve the reference's visible facial proportions and dark eyes, with her face turned slightly toward the camera, an attentive gaze and a faint almost amused smile. She wears charcoal straight-leg trousers, simple black flat shoes and a soft ivory blouse whose loose hem hangs toward the street. The quiet closeness of her expression provides a subtle human attraction within the disorienting space. Use a portrait photograph from an upright camera on the arcade floor, a medium-wide lens and a nearly frontal view that keeps both sole-to-brick contacts, her face and the street's vertical markers simultaneously clear. Soft late-afternoon side light picks out brick texture and a warm contour along her cheek, with natural pores, believable fabric weight and crisp contact shadows. The entire composition turns around the contradiction between her inverted standing position and the normal street below.

literals.u0: In an ordinary hallway, one doorway is formed from translucent sewn fabric with visible hinge and latch shapes stitched into it. A lower corner of the same doorway folds onto the floor, exposing its fabric hem, while a solid wooden doorway beside it retains normal thickness. The stitched opening, folded corner and neighboring wooden reference are visible together.
